title: Apply the CSS Box Model with Border-Box
task: Configure a styled box component using the four layers of the box model. In your HTML, add an element with `class="card"`. In your CSS, define `.card` with `padding: 16px`, `border: 2px solid #2563eb`, `margin: 24px`, and `box-sizing: border-box`.

In CSS, create a `.card` rule set defining `padding`, `border`, `margin`, and `box-sizing`.
Set `box-sizing: border-box` so the padding and border are contained within the element bounds.

rules.message: HTML must contain an element with class='card'.
CSS rule '.card' must set 'border' to '2px solid #2563eb'.
